title: One meaning for 'the advisor', and an advisor answer is shown to be real
why: Your worry, Oct 26: the advisor setup is delicate, and your Mac sessions seem to report an advisor review that may not exist.
note: Checked at claude-settings 149f4bc5, Oct 26. Three things are called advisor: (1) Claude Code's built-in advisor, on through settings.json advisorModel: opus, a stronger model a session consults on its own (exact behaviour in the app not checked); (2) the terminal advisor, a session named advisor-xx started by start-advisor.ps1 from C:\advisor, Windows only, no Mac launcher; (3) this cloud project, which answers only you. Rule questions-ask-advisor-first and the report label 'Decided by the advisor' mean (2) only, but nothing checks that a listed answer came from a real SendMessage to advisor-xx; and any session in a folder starting 'advisor' (such as a normal session opened in the advisor repo) gets an advisor- name and would be taken for it (known gap in decision advisor-answers-questions). On the Mac, (2) never runs, so a 'Decided by the advisor' item there likely came from (1) or was made up (unverified: no Mac report seen). Last live check of (2): Oct 23. Plan: first read one Mac report that cites the advisor; then (a) rename the label and rule to name only the advisor- session and say the built-in advisor is a second opinion, never a decision; (b) the report gate refuses a 'Decided by the advisor' item when the session sent no SendMessage to advisor-xx. Ruling needed from you on keeping (2) at all.
ask: No brief yet. Needs one Mac report that cites the advisor, then your pick on keeping the terminal advisor.
